description: Interview Resources | 2 Full Stack AI Engineer, 1 GTM | REMOTE | Full-Time | $250k seed raised Interview Resources is building an AI-powered deep research platform for interview preparation. Instead of generic interview guides, we autonomously research company-specific interview experiences across Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn, engineering blogs, company websites, Glassdoor, and other public sources, then generate structured preparation reports in minutes. We are already profitable with 3k+ paid users. Our stack currently includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Vercel, AWS, and modern AI tooling. Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, RAG, vector databases, or AI agents is a strong plus, but curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter more. We're looking for someone who: Has strong full-stack engineering skills. Has built and deployed production applications. Loves working with AI and LLM-powered products. Takes ownership and ships quickly. Has personal projects or open-source work they're proud of. Expected salary: $30k – $90k (flexible based on experience, impact, and per capita) Expected Joining Date: 1st October To apply, visit https://www.interviewresources.app/careers (No Email; my email is spammed) with: 1. Your CV/Resume. Your GitHub profile. 2. Why do you like InterviewResources? (product-driven answer) Log in to the site and just see some sample reports. 3. One piece of work or project you're most proud of (include links if possible). 4. Please include your expected salary and location in your application. Human-written messages are more likely to get a response. Try: https://www.interviewresources.app
